verdict.rationale: Rippling documents rule-based automation triggering actions on events—dynamic access rules on role changes (docs-3, docs-18), custom security policy workflows notifying on threats (docs-6, docs-7), and event-triggered inventory automation like offboarding retrieval flows (docs-8). The tagline 'You define the rules, Rippling runs the rest' (docs-27) directly matches the story. Missing for 10: no hands-on/independent verification of custom rule authoring UI, no detail on the specific rule-definition syntax or conditions/actions granularity, and no third-party corroboration of reliability.
